verdict.rationale: Cognee documents `.improve()` for enriching an existing graph after new data is ingested and `.forget()` for deletion, which together provide some update/merge capability, but neither doc explicitly describes detecting and resolving contradictions between old and new facts. A founder comment even states temporal-resolution mechanisms for handling conflicting/updated facts are still 'being built,' indicating the core supersede/merge-on-contradiction logic is not yet a confirmed shipped feature. missing for 10: documented conflict-detection/resolution logic, confirmation that temporal resolution feature is released (not still in development), independent evidence of correct merge behavior on contradictory inputs.
